properties.title: National Aggregates of Geospatial Data Collection: Population, Landscape, And Climate Estimates, Version 3 (PLACE III)
properties.description: The National Aggregates of Geospatial Data Collection: Population, Landscape, And Climate Estimates, Version 3 (PLACE III) data set contains estimates of national-level aggregations in urban, rural, and total designations of territorial extent and population size by biome, climate zone, coastal proximity zone, elevation zone, and population density zone, for 232 statistical areas (countries and other UN recognized territories). This data set is produced by the Columbia University Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN).
keywords: EARTH SCIENCE > LAND SURFACE > TOPOGRAPHY > TERRAIN ELEVATION
properties.ciesin:tags: Climate, Population, Sustainability, Climatology/Meteorology/Atmosphere, Environment, Imagery/Base Maps/Earth Cover, Society, Global, Continent, Country, Earth Science, Human Dimensions, Boundaries, Land Surface, Topography, Terrain Elevation
properties.ciesin:purpose: To provide tabular data to researchers without GIS capabilities who need data on population and land area by country across a range of physical characteristics. These include measures such as the number of persons living within coastal zones, the percent of a region within specific elevation strata, or the number of persons living within different climate zones.
properties.ciesin:data_format: map, tabular, map service; tabular; map, tabular
ciesin:contacts: Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN) Metadata Administration
NASA Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center (SEDAC)
